name: manual_afda99
claim: Treat .claude/hooks/.logs/hook-log.jsonl as transient runtime telemetry, never as a reviewed ECC overlay: the autoresearch hook helper appends per-session records under its current working directory. Preserve hook behavior and tests as the durable artifact; keep generated evidence local or in a deliberate audit system, and exclude it from submodule overlay candidates.

decisions.notes: Historical reconstruction: the original June 13 ECC overlay retained only three real configuration files. A privacy-warning telemetry record from that date was later promoted into the overlay during the July 15 reclassification because it looked like useful security evidence. August runtime records from rule-reminder, iteration-context, and privacy hooks proved the log is append-only operational output rather than configuration. A fixed one-record patch therefore becomes stale and blocks safe ECC updates.
